source: E[Q] PDF visualizer records; one row per legal action with an 85-bin PDF over E[Q] values -42..42.

features.name: mean
features.notes: Scalar E[Q]; useful baseline but intentionally not sufficient.

features.name: std
features.notes: Distribution spread from sampled hidden worlds.

features.name: make_mass
features.notes: Offense-side mass at E[Q] >= 18; null for defense rows.

features.name: set_mass
features.notes: Defense-side threshold mass using the visualizer's E[Q] > -18 rule; null for offense rows.

features.name: lower_tail_mass
features.notes: Mass at E[Q] <= -18; a compact tail-risk indicator.

features.name: q10/q25/q50/q75/q90
features.notes: Empirical quantiles from the PDF bins.

features.name: cvar_low_10
features.notes: Approximate expectation over the lowest 10% of mass.

features.name: branch_entropy
features.notes: Entropy of the E[Q] PDF; crude branchiness indicator.

features.name: branch_peak_count
features.notes: Number of local PDF peaks with at least 2% mass.

features.name: shelf_gap
features.notes: Distance between lowest and highest local peak bins when at least two shelves are visible.

features.name: high_variance_close_mean
features.notes: Action is within one E[Q] point of the best mean and in the decision's upper spread quartile.

features.name: scalar_ev_lying_by_omission
features.notes: Top-mean action hides threshold, lower-tail, or high-variance evidence worth reporting.

live_inference_note: These features require sampled-world E[Q] PDFs. They are cheap once the offline visualizer tensor exists, but too expensive for a live selector unless a smaller model learns to predict them from legal public state.
